subject.title: fix(qqbot): require own account credential entries

question: Should QQBot treat only own enumerable properties on programmatic account objects as supported configuration, even when prototype-inherited values previously resolved at runtime?
rationale: The patch is internally consistent and proven, but it intentionally changes behavior for non-JSON programmatic configuration objects; the supported compatibility contract is a maintainer product decision.

options.title: Adopt own-property configuration
options.body: Treat prototype-inherited QQBot account and credential values as unsupported noncanonical configuration and merge the focused hardening patch.

options.title: Preserve inherited programmatic values
options.body: Keep prototype-inherited account values supported and redesign cleanup or validation around an explicitly documented programmatic configuration contract.

recommendation.title: Adopt own-property configuration
recommendation.body: Treat prototype-inherited QQBot account and credential values as unsupported noncanonical configuration and merge the focused hardening patch.
